challenge.results: Szeredi assigns CDL2 to implementation work and Warren's model to execution architecture. He identifies Prolog as the implemented language. The comparison describes extensions and gives no edition-specific compatibility result.

limitations: This identifies the implemented language family in the participant account without claiming compatibility with each edition.
